_comment: fm435 caster_lift_m enablement. The mission imports the mobile base from the manifest's generated URDF, so the lift is baked into that URDF at build time (build_mobile_assets.py --config), NOT a runtime config flag. To use lifted casters: (1) regenerate the mobile asset with the spec override below, then (2) point the mission's mobile_manifest at the regenerated manifest. caster_lift_m=0.0 (default/absent) => legacy co-planar contacts, byte-identical.
evidence: Uncoupled base-drive bench at real mu=1.0: straight tracking 0.097 (co-planar) -> 0.988 (lift 5mm); arc v 0.985, arc omega 0.851, within_tol true. data/mobile-restock-v2/report.md 2026-10-21.
